title: Colluding Against Environmental Regulation
abstract: We study collusion among firms against imperfectly monitored environmental regulation. Firms increase variable profits by violating regulation and reduce expected noncompliance penalties by violating jointly. We consider a case of three German automakers colluding to reduce the effectiveness of emissions control technology. By estimating a structural model of the European automobile industry from 2007 to 2018, we find that collusion lowers expected noncompliance penalties substantially and increases buyer and producer surplus. Due to increased pollution, welfare decreases by € 1.57–5.57 billion. We show how environmental policy design and antitrust play complementary roles in preventing noncompliance.
abstract_zh: 我们研究了企业在环境规制监管不完善的情况下相互串通的行为。企业通过违规排放来增加可变利润，并通过共同违规来降低预期的违规处罚。我们考察了三家德国汽车制造商串通以削弱排放控制技术有效性的案例。通过对2007至2018年欧洲汽车行业的结构模型进行估计，我们发现，串通大幅降低了预期的违规处罚，并增加了买方和生产者剩余。由于污染加剧，社会福利减少了15.7亿至55.7亿欧元。我们说明了环境政策设计与反垄断政策在防止违规方面发挥的互补作用。

Acceptance Sampling for Cost-Effective Surveillance of Emerald Ash Borer in Urban Environments
venue: Forestry: An International Journal of Forest Research
abstract: We develop an acceptance sampling approach for surveillance of the emerald ash borer (EAB), a harmful forest pest, in Winnipeg, Canada. We compare sampling strategies computed with two different management objectives. The first objective maximizes the expected area with detected infestations and the second objective minimizes the expected number of undetected infested trees in sites that were not inspected or where inspection did not find an infestation. The choice of the management objective influences the survey strategy: achieving the first objective involves selecting sites with high infestation rates proximal to the infested area, whereas the second objective requires inspecting sites with both high infestation rates and high host densities. Adding uncertainty prescribes inspecting a larger area with lower sampling rates and extending the surveys to farther distances from the infested locations. If a decision maker wants to minimize the worst-case damage from failed detections, the optimal strategy is to survey more sites with high host densities at farther distances, where EAB arrivals could cause significant damage if not detected quickly. Accounting for the uncertainty addresses possible variation in infestation rates and helps develop a more diversified survey strategy. The approach is generalizable and can support survey programmes for new pest incursions.
abstract_zh: 我们提出了一种接受抽样方法，用于监测加拿大温尼伯市城市环境中的白蜡窄吉丁（emerald ash borer, EAB）——一种危害性很大的森林害虫。我们比较了基于两种不同管理目标计算出的抽样策略。第一种目标是最大化发现虫害的预期面积；第二种目标是最小化未检查地点或检查未发现虫害地点中未被发现的受侵染树木的预期数量。管理目标的选择会影响调查策略：实现第一种目标需要选择靠近已受侵染区域、虫害率较高的地点；而实现第二种目标则需要检查虫害率和寄主密度都较高的地点。加入不确定性后，建议检查范围更大、抽样率更低，并将调查延伸至距离已受侵染地点更远的区域。如果决策者希望将未能及时发现虫害所造成的最坏损失降到最低，最优策略是在寄主密度较高、距离较远的地点增加调查数量，因为在这些地点，若不能迅速发现，EAB的传入可能造成重大损失。考虑不确定性有助于处理虫害率可能存在的变异，并有助于形成更加多元化的调查策略。该方法具有普遍适用性，可用于支持新入侵害虫的监测项目。

title: Managing Biological Invasions in Urban Environments with the Acceptance Sampling Approach
abstract: Detections of invasive species outbreaks are often followed by the removal of susceptible host organisms in order to slow the spread of the invading pest population. We propose the acceptance sampling approach for detection and optional removal of susceptible host trees to manage an outbreak of the emerald ash borer (EAB), a highly destructive forest pest, in Winnipeg, Canada. We compare the strategy with two common delimiting survey techniques that do not consider follow-up management actions such as host removal. Our results show that the management objective influences the survey strategy. The survey-only strategies maximized the capacity to detect new infestations and prioritized sites with high likelihood of being invaded. Comparatively, the surveys with subsequent host removal actions allocated most of the budget to sites where complete host removal would minimize the pest's ability to spread to uninvaded locations. Uncertainty about the pest's spread causes the host removal measures to cover a larger area in a uniform spatial pattern and extend to farther distances from already infested sites. If a decision maker is ambiguity-averse and strives to avoid the worst-case damages from the invasion, the optimal strategy is to survey more sites with high host densities and remove trees from sites at farther distances, where EAB arrivals may be uncertain, but could cause significant damage if not detected quickly. Accounting for the uncertainty about spread helps develop a more robust pest management strategy. The approach is generalizable and can support management programs for new pest incursions.
abstract_zh: 入侵物种爆发被发现后，通常会移除易感寄主生物，以减缓入侵害虫种群的扩散。我们提出以接受抽样方法来检测虫害，并可选择性地移除易感寄主树木，以应对加拿大温尼伯市白蜡窄吉丁（EAB）——一种破坏性很强的森林害虫——的爆发。我们将该策略与两种常见的界定性调查技术进行了比较，这两种技术都不考虑移除寄主等后续管理措施。结果表明，管理目标会影响调查策略：仅开展调查的策略能够最大化发现新侵染的能力，并优先选择被入侵可能性高的地点。相比之下，包含后续寄主移除措施的调查，则会将大部分预算分配给那些完全移除寄主即可最大限度阻止害虫向未受侵染地点扩散的地点。由于害虫扩散情况存在不确定性，寄主移除措施会以均匀的空间格局覆盖更大的范围，并延伸至距离已受侵染地点更远的区域。如果决策者厌恶模糊性，并力求避免入侵造成的最坏损失，最优策略是在寄主密度较高的地点增加调查数量，并在距离较远、EAB传入情况尚不确定但若不能迅速发现可能造成重大损失的地点移除树木。考虑扩散的不确定性有助于制定更加稳健的害虫管理策略。该方法具有普遍适用性，可用于支持新入侵害虫的管理项目。
